explanation: Rook, Knight, Bishop, and Queen are all chess pieces that can move multiple squares (or jump over pieces, in the Knight's case) in a single turn and are not restricted to one-step forward movement. A Pawn typically moves only one square forward at a time, making it the outlier.
Hamlet, Othello, Macbeth, and King Lear are all major tragedies written by William Shakespeare. 'A Midsummer Night's Dream' is one of Shakespeare's most famous comedies, making it the outlier.

Foot, Base, Basket, and Volley can each precede the word 'ball' to form the name of a sport (Football, Baseball, Basketball, Volleyball). 'Crystal' can precede 'ball' (Crystal Ball), but it does not form the name of a sport.
